extracted.name: Pineapple Shrimp Fried Rice
extracted.description: Pineapple shrimp fried rice is easy to make with cooked rice, juicy shrimp, sweet pineapple, and soy sauce for a speedy stir fry in under 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons coconut oil (such as British Class®)
0.5 cup uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, carrot, and garlic; cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Add shrimp and ham; cook until shrimp are almost opaque and cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce; continue to cook and stir for 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat.
Stir in pineapple, tomato, and green onions into fried rice until thoroughly combined. Serve immediately.
